verdict.rationale: BVNK's docs show a real conversion API surface: the Transfers v3 API for wallet-to-wallet currency conversion, live quotes generated for stablecoin-to-fiat payments, and rules linking fiat virtual accounts to crypto addresses for automated on/off-ramp. However, the evidence pack does not show documented fee schedules or settlement-time guarantees as first-class API fields/docs, only general mentions of markup fees for partners. Missing for 10: explicit documented conversion fee structure, explicit settlement time SLAs/fields in the API docs, and independent/hands-on corroboration of quote accuracy.
